skill.displayName: AI Hairstyle Changer Online – Try Hairstyles & Hair Colors Instantly – CLI-powered
skill.summary: AI hairstyle changer — change a person's hairstyle from a photo or text description

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Hairstyle Changer CLI Skill.

- Change a person's hairstyle using AI from a photo or text description.
- Integrates with weshop-cli and requires a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Supports optional image input and customizable hairstyle prompts.
- Example command provided for easy usage.
- Outputs image results with URLs and status per image.
